content:
kai wu: Hey team — opened a PR to tweak prefetch window + batching heuristics to avoid KV prefetch collisions under high concurrency. pinging runtime folks for a quick look: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-runtime/pull/4234  short summary: reduce prefetch backoff, fix batcher drain race, add opt-in env REDWOOD_PREFETCH_STRICT. low-risk but touches hotpath, hoping to merge in the next 2hr window.

jess r: taking a look now. can you paste perf numbers? esp p99 tail.

kai wu: perf in PR description: ~5–7% lower avg token latency on mixed workload, p99 improved ~10ms on long-context runs. added unit test for kv eviction + repro steps (test/readme).

omar p: i saw CI failed on attn-tiling earlier, could be unrelated flake. what's failing exactly? logs?

ci-bot: build #7892 failed: runtime/test_attn_tiling.py::TestTiling::test_tiling_edge_case — segfault in CUDA kernel launch. logs: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/builds/7892/log

samantha l: i can debug the segfault if we need to gate merge. did you rebase on main? there was a tiny kernel ABI change yesterday.

kai wu: rebased onto main and kicked CI. deploy-bot: please run a smoke-only tag 'fast-merge' after tests.

deploy-bot: Triggered smoke suite for PR 4234 (fast-merge).

jess r: quick diff scan looks fine. one nit: rename env var REDWOOD_PREFETCH_STRICT -> PREFETCH_STRICT to match our env naming conventions. otherwise LGTM.

omar p: small concern: the new shard lock in batcher — could that induce contention at very high qps? can you add a microbench or note in changelog?

kai wu: added microbench results to PR comments; lock is per-shard, not global. will add a changelog entry and push a tiny rename commit for the env.

kai wu: pushed fixes (env rename, changelog entry, test tweak). kicked CI again.

ci-bot: build #7895 passed unit tests; integration smoke hit GPU mem-pressure test failure (known flaky).

samantha l: given unit tests are green and the smoke failure is a flaky mem-pressure test, i'm fine merging in the 2hr merge slot. @jess r @omar p any objections?

jess r: no objections from me. :thumbsup:

omar p: okay to merge, but please watch telemetry post-rollout. set canary to 5% first.

kai wu: will rollout with canary 5% then 25% after 30m if no regressions. rollout command: ```
redwood rollout --service runtime --pr 4234 --canary 5% --wait 30m
```  thanks everyone for the quick reviews — i'll follow up with telemetry notes and a post-merge checklist.
